title: RiderLeft
description: Server to the host only (ADR 0007 section 2): `left` when the rider token's last connection closed (it may come back within 5 minutes and is then announced again), `dropped` when the host removed the rider.

rider.description: The rider's id: 8 random bytes, base64url without padding, given by the server at the join, never derived from the token or the nickname, the same for the token's whole life.
